claim_scope: all-train-pool phase-WFP capacity selection; not validation/test promotion
hypothesis: A high-capacity full-support phase-WFP will strictly improve two-seed train-confirmation error over the E1d-capacity base network when trained on the complete group-disjoint all-train pool.
primary_metric: two-seed mean 96-record train-confirmation physical 64-bin relative L2
self_approval: User explicitly authorized automatic launch and agent approval after prerequisite terminal gates pass.
failure_signal: Reject high capacity and stop before validation if high two-seed confirmation mean is not strictly lower than base or any contract gate fails.
rollback: Additive; preserve all prior checkpoints. Keep best/latest only per new lane.
